wholePhysicalScope: The named 22-corner building and the service driveway define the principal residence footprint and its access.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the connected house sections, mapped driveway and covered entrance. Near levels refine the roof ridge, window frames and entrance columns.
limitations: The full connected house footprint and driveway are mapped. Roof subdivisions, unphotographed façades, wall heights and the vertical site registration are estimates.
The public-domain photo fixes the visible entry form, column and roof character, and cool green finish. The exact columns and canopy dimensions are estimated.
The Shilin park, separate guest accommodation, Victory Chapel and hilltop pavilion are outside the footprint of this main house model.
The preserved elevation rises substantially into the garden behind the house. The three section levels and foundations use approximate contacts on that slope.
